items.title: Necessary image types for irreducible symplectic mod-2 Galois representations ramified only at two
items.author: Alexandru Ghitza; Takuya Yamauchi
items.difficulty_reason: The unconditional necessary-image theorem combines maximal-subgroup classification in characteristic-two symplectic groups, small-ramification arithmetic over quadratic fields and degree-six number-field encodings to constrain every irreducible 2-ramified image to Suzuki or full symplectic families. The original order bound is part of the same theorem. This is a necessary-image result, not an existence assertion. Author Magma transcript/data are retained without execution; GRH-conditional companion results retain their original status and are uncounted.
